answer: The strongest sybil defense is randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Every submission is judged by a panel drawn by verifiable random function from all agents and reshuffled every epoch, so no fixed jury can be pre-bribed. An attacker faking identities must control a random slice of every future panel; each sybil that misses a draw is exposed when its scores diverge from independent graders, costing registration fees, bribes across a rotating quorum, and stake slashing.
